  • Collaborate with systems and software teams to validate dynamic models against simulation and flight test data.

  • Demonstrated experience with Python and engineering workflow automation.

  • Degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, AI Agents, and modern MDO tools.

  • Experience in unmanned aerial systems (UAS) or rapid-prototyping defence environments.

description:

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.

You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.
  • Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.
  • Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.
  • Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.
  • Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.
  • Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.
  • Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.
  • Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).
  • Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.
  • Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.
  • A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.
  • Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.
  • Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.
  • Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.
  • Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.

Why This Role

You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Senior Front Office Support Engineer
description:
The Role
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Front Office Support Engineer to join our expanding global Front Office Support and Automation team in London. The Front Office Support team is embedded within our Portfolio Management and Trading teams, providing monitoring, maintenance, and support of our most business-critical systems. You will be responsible for solving complex problems for our investment professionals and stakeholders and will serve as the first point of contact for troubleshooting any issues with our trading platform.

What makes this role interesting 
The Front Office Support Engineer will focus on providing critical support for our EMEA-based Fundamental Equity and Tactical Trading Portfolio Managers, Traders and Analysts. You will manage a dynamic workload and gain exposure to many interesting facets of the firm, including but not limited to:

  • Front-row seat to the markets: You will sit on the trading floor, embedded with our Portfolio Management teams, with real-time exposure to multi-asset strategies and decision-making.
  • Impact from day one: Resolving a production incident or supporting a Portfolio Manager has an immediate effect on PnL.
  • Build and run: We don't just troubleshoot, we optimise. You'll have the autonomy to identify repetitive pain points and work with partner teams to automate and evolve our processes.
  • Global perspective: Follow-the-sun coverage means close collaboration with support teams in the US and APAC, so you'll learn and share best practices globally.

What you'll do

  • Incident ownership: Triage, diagnose, and resolve real-time trading issues across our Order Management System (OMS)/Execution Management System (EMS), Bloomberg, and proprietary trading and execution tools/systems.
  • Stakeholder management: Act as the technology "first responder" - our liaison and primary bridge between our front office users (traders and Portfolio Managers) and core engineering teams, translating trading requests into actionable technical work.
  • Service reliability: Maintain and evolve our monitoring, alerting, and post-incident review processes, and help drive a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Project execution: Lead projects from ideation and requirements gathering through to production. 

What You’ll Bring
What you need 

  • 4+ years of financial services experience supporting traders and Portfolio Managers (ideally at a hedge fund, investment bank, or electronic market-maker).
  • Experience working with Order Management Systems (OMS), Execution Management Systems (EMS), and Portfolio Management Systems (PMS) trading stacks.
  • Experience supporting front office vendor trading systems (e.g. Portware, Enfusion, Neovest) - Knowledge of equities, futures, FX, and/or options trading strategies.
  • Working knowledge of trading workflows, FIX, market data vendors (Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv), and broker algos - Technical skills including SQL, FIX Protocol and Excel/VBA.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication - ability to translate and explain complex issues to non-technical users.
  • Ability to maintain composure under pressure, take initiative in problem-solving, and identify root causes
  • Strong sense of ownership and a track record of delivering results.

Nice to have

  • Proven AI tooling experience - Scripting experience with Python.
  • Strong business analysis and project management skills.
  • Exposure to APIs - Derivatives and valuation experience - you understand Greeks, pricing models, and how traders interpret them, or have experience supporting systems that perform these calculations.

Who we are
Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income.
Our Culture
At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
United Kingdom (Remote)

 

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees: while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether you’re engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with your marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stack and is powered by a world-class team with hubs in New York, London, and Lisbon.

 

About the Role

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst to help us understand performance, plan for the future, and make better business decisions. Reporting to our CFO, you'll own core planning and forecasting, turn data into clear insights and recommendations, and work directly with leaders and teams across the business to improve decisions and execution.

Our business model uniquely combines SaaS and prepaid customer wallets with a global gift marketplace, branded merchandise, and international fulfilment. That creates complex planning and analysis across recurring and transactional revenue, margins, cash and wallet dynamics, and multiple entities and currencies.

Your impact will extend well beyond building models and reporting numbers. You'll bring ideas and perspective, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and help turn analysis into action. You'll be equally adept at getting into the details and stepping back to understand what the numbers mean for the business.

You'll work across NetSuite, Salesforce, DealHub, and our reporting tools, with a strong focus on automation and AI, helping build an FP&A function that is insightful, efficient, and closely connected to the business.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the consolidated operating model and rolling P&L and cash forecasts across entities and revenue streams, including customer wallet balances.
  • Own the annual budget and quarterly forecasting process, with clear analysis of performance, variances, risks, and opportunities.
  • Work directly with leaders and budget holders across the business to understand performance, challenge assumptions, solve problems, and drive work through completion.
  • Prepare monthly management reporting and board and investor materials, turning financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Analyse unit economics and margin by revenue stream to support pricing, deal, investment, and other commercial decisions.
  • Define and maintain consistent definitions for key business metrics, including ARR, retention, and margin by revenue stream, ensuring they reconcile to reported financials each month.
  • Calculate sales commissions and support the design and review of commission plans.
  • Provide transaction analysis to support tax decisions, including VAT registrations and disclosures, and US sales tax thresholds.
  • Maintain accurate dashboards and self-service performance reporting for budget holders and leadership, partnering with our business systems team on data and integrations.
  • Improve and automate forecasting, reporting, and variance analysis, using AI and other tools to increase the speed and quality of our work.

 

About You

  • Typically 2–5 years of relevant experience with increasing responsibility in FP&A, corporate finance, audit, transaction services, or another highly analytical finance role.
  • Excellent financial modelling skills, including driver-based forecasting and experience building or working with integrated financial models.
  • Strong business judgement and curiosity, with the ability to move from analysis to clear implications, recommendations, and action.
  • Proven ability to take ownership, work effectively across teams, build credibility with non-finance colleagues, and drive work through completion.
  • Strong accounting foundation and the ability to connect operational metrics, forecasts, and financial results back to the general ledger.
  • Skilled at working with data across multiple systems; ERP and CRM experience is valuable, with NetSuite and Salesforce preferred.
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI and automation tools, with a track record of applying them to improve the speed and quality of Finance work.
  • Clear, concise communicator who can explain complex analysis to non-finance audiences and produce high-quality materials for senior leaders and the board.
  • Proactive, highly organised, and effective in a fast-moving international business where priorities can evolve quickly.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SaaS metrics such as ARR, retention, and cohort analysis.
  • Experience with marketplace, physical goods, prepaid, or payments business models.
  • Experience with multi-entity or multi-currency planning across the UK, US, or Europe.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Looker, or similar data and reporting tools.
  • Exposure to sales commissions, indirect tax, or other transaction-level financial analysis.
  • Part-qualified or fully qualified ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification is a plus.

 

The Benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Apply scripting and configuration management practices to support system maintenance, operational consistency, and service improvements.
